APPROVED_SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENT_CONT.objective: Recover the inherited multi-site Ansible fleet automation under /app/fleet-automation as a supported, portable and convergent production configuration system.
material_requirements: supported Ansible runtime with project-local configuration/bootstrap discovery
portable repository-local role discovery with correct role identity, dependency ordering, handler behavior and host boundaries
Vault-encrypted sensitive data at rest with noninteractive documented execution
valid Ansible YAML, task/action and module schemas without shell bypasses
correct heterogeneous endpoint/site/policy/telemetry rendering including cross-host aggregation, optional groups, numeric ordering, IPv4 and IPv6
preserve production service/policy catalogs, three-site inventory, operator evidence, state/rollout engines, destinations and operating contracts
full supplied fleet playbook and semantic validation succeed
unchanged second execution converges idempotently without churn, duplication or state drift

avoid: task details copied from unrelated calibration domains
must_preserve: Recover a realistic multi-site Ansible fleet configuration system from layered controller, discovery, Vault, orchestration, parser/schema, Jinja/data-shape, IPv6, telemetry, policy-ordering and convergence failures while preserving production-scale catalogs and operator evidence.
Repair parser/task/module-schema errors without shell bypasses.
Use a supported Ansible runtime and restore project-local config/bootstrap behavior.
Full execution succeeds and unchanged second run is idempotent.
Render heterogeneous endpoint/site/policy/telemetry data correctly including IPv6.
Correct dependency ordering and host responsibility boundaries.
Preserve production topology, catalogs, evidence and operating contracts.
Project roles must resolve portably from the repository.
Sensitive production data must be Vault-encrypted at rest and available noninteractively to the project run.
structure: state the approved engineering objective first
preserve exact public contracts and hard safety/state constraints
reference solver-visible technical contracts instead of reproducing hidden verifier rows
